title: Boone County Fiscal Court — October 6, 2026 agenda and minutes-index authority check
authorityBoundary: As of 2026-10-03, the official Boone County Fiscal Court current agenda is for the upcoming October 6, 2026 meeting. Its Ordinances section states None, and the reliably extracted agenda contains no reviewed zoning-rewrite/adoption/effective-date target term. This establishes only what was scheduled on that posted agenda; it does not establish what action may ultimately occur at the October 6 meeting, whether an agenda may later be amended, or whether another legislative body has acted.
minutesBoundary: The live Fiscal Court minutes index links 2026 regular-meeting minutes through September 8. The October 6 agenda itself references approval of September 22 regular-meeting and September 24 caucus-meeting minutes, so absence of later links on the index is not treated as proof that later meetings or minutes do not exist.
adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations Article 34 as sign-regulation authority unless reviewed official action records establish final adoption and effectiveness of replacement text.
nextLogicalAuthorityTarget: After October 6, recheck the official Fiscal Court agenda/minutes for posted October 6 action records; otherwise inspect the October 20 agenda when posted for zoning-rewrite adoption items.
